knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Damage is recorded with its location and reported. The cleaner does not repair it, and hiding it creates a false record.
A found item is recorded, secured and passed through the approved return route. The cleaner does not keep it or hand it to whoever is nearby.
The record states what was found. Attribution is left to the coordinator and the property manager, so the cleaner does not name a guest.

practicalCriteria: Records a simulated damaged fitting with location, description, time and photograph reference, without repairing it.
Records and secures a simulated found item with a matching reference, and passes it through the approved route with a handover record.
Makes a simulated broken-glass hazard safe, without handling the glass with bare hands, and reports it.
Keeps the record free of attribution statements and of any opinion about the guest.
passRule: Damage and found item recorded correctly, nothing repaired, kept or hidden, hazard made safe, and no attribution in the record. Observed in a supervised simulation. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
stopWorkCriteria: Found item kept by the cleaner
Broken glass handled with bare hands
Record names a guest as the cause
